```yaml
name: Build

on:
  push:
    branches: ["main"]
  pull_request:
    branches: ["main"]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: "true"

      - name: Use Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build dependencies
        run: yarn build:deps

      - name: Build web application
        run: yarn workspace @sourcebot/web build

      - name: Build backend
        run: yarn workspace @sourcebot/backend build

      - name: Build MCP
        run: yarn workspace @sourcebot/mcp build

      - name: Build database
        run: yarn workspace @sourcebot/db build

      - name: Build shared packages
        run: yarn workspace @sourcebot/shared build

      - name: Build query language
        run: yarn workspace @sourcebot/query-language build

      - name: Build Docker image
        id: build
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: .
          push: false
          tags: sourcebot:latest
          build-args: |
            NEXT_PUBLIC_SOURCEBOT_CLOUD_ENVIRONMENT=development
            NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_ENVIRONMENT=development
            NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_WEBAPP_DSN=
            NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_BACKEND_DSN=
            NEXT_PUBLIC_LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY=
            NEXT_PUBLIC_LANGFUSE_BASE_URL=
```
